_doc: token_order.npy = descending token frequency in 22.4M target-generated response tokens (16000 responses of Qwen3.8-27B to prompts from HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k train_sft + openai/gsm8k train only, with the authors' own system prompts / answer-language instructions); built with tools/build_draft_vocab.py. Coverage below = share of response tokens inside the first n ids on a separate held-out set of target responses (evaluation only).
